messages.subject: Curve Fitting in GGPlot2
parts:
I am trying to fit a four parameter logistic regression (hill model to
be specific) to dose response data for drugs. I want to calculate IC50
and predicted asymptote maximum values and plot these as text on the
plot .

My vision is to have several facets each with a geom_point for the
individual points, a geom_smooth with the regression with (with alpha
levels of 95% confidence intervals around the fit), and a geom_text of
the IC50 values.

I have not been able to find the appropriate function to use in
geom_smooth that gives a correct 4 parameter logistic hill model fit.

Could anyone point me in the direction of such a function that works
with ggplot2?

Many Thanks,
Dan Gillie

At a certain point of complexity I think you have to break down and
fit the models yourself, then generate data frames with predicted values
and confidence intervals, then add them as layers to the plot with
geom_line and geom_ribbon ... (and the values with geom_text).
I believe gnls, or nlsList (both nlme package) will allow you to fit a
hill model partitioned with different parameters per group (factor).

Ben Bolker
